name: Perfex Pulse
author: karamble
description: Outstanding receivables from a Perfex CRM in the bar, with overdue invoices in a click-open panel and a hard on/off switch for polling.

barWidget.description: Outstanding receivables, live. Click for overdue invoices; the switch stops every request.

schema.label: Query the CRM
schema.description: Off means the widget makes no network requests at all; the bar shows the greyed mark alone and the panel keeps the last numbers.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: 3 + one call per open invoice per poll. The floor keeps a typo from flooding the audit log.

schema.label: Show the amount in the bar
schema.description: Off shows the Perfex mark alone; the tooltip and the panel still show the numbers.

schema.label: Overdue invoices listed in the panel
Show 'Paid this month' (+1 call per poll)
Notify when an invoice becomes overdue
CRM base URL (for links)
schema.description: Used only to open invoices in the browser. The API endpoint is stored next to the key by the setup wizard.
